name: Siren Call
text: Revelation - Put Siren Call into play in your threat area. As an additional cost to commit 1 or more cards to a skill test, you must pay 1 resource for each matching skill icon those cards have. [action][action]: Discard Siren Call.
text_cn: 显现 - 将海妖之唤放置入你的威胁区域。 作为投入卡牌到技能检定的额外费用，那些卡牌每有一个匹配的技能图标，你必须支付1资源。 [action][action]：丢弃海妖之唤。
